definition_zh: 地理的；地理学的；地理位置的；按地区划分的
definition_en: relating to geography, to the physical features and arrangement of places on the earth, or to the way things are distributed across regions
core_image: 一张摊开的等高线地图，河流与山脊被细线描出
scene: 这里指「地理的」。 In geographical terms the two towns are close, yet a mountain range separates them.
sceneCN: 这里 geographical 是「地理位置上」的（第 1 个义项：就空间位置而言）；句意：从地理上说这两座城镇很近，却有一道山脉把二者隔开。图中可辨识物件：等高线地图、山脉符号、河流、比例尺、指南针。

pos.zh: 地理的；地理学的；地理位置的；按地区划分的（多作定语）

collocations.zh: 地理标志（贸易与知识产权术语）

derivatives.zh: 地缘政治（共用 geo- 前缀）

senses.title: Of location on the earth
senses.titleCN: 地理位置的：就所处空间而言
senses.definition: relating to where a place sits on the earth's surface
senses.definitionCN: 关于某地在球面上所处位置的
senses.example: Their geographical position makes the harbour ice-free all winter.
senses.exampleCN: 它们的地理位置使这个港口整个冬天不结冰。
senses.why: geo- is Greek for 'earth' and -graphy means 'writing, description'; geographical therefore marks anything to do with describing the earth's places.
senses.whyCN: geo- 是希腊语“大地”，-graphy 意为“书写、描述”，因此 geographical 标记的是与描述大地各处有关的事物。

senses.title: Of geography as a science
senses.titleCN: 地理学的：作为一门学科
senses.definition: belonging to the academic study of the earth's surface, climate and human use of it
senses.definitionCN: 属于研究地表、气候及人类利用方式的学科
senses.example: The journal publishes geographical research on migration.
senses.exampleCN: 该刊发表关于人口迁移的地理学研究。
senses.why: Once geography became a university discipline in the 19th century, the adjective also named its methods, journals and departments.
senses.whyCN: 地理学在 19 世纪成为大学学科之后，这个形容词也用来指称其方法、刊物与院系。

senses.title: Of terrain and landforms
senses.titleCN: 地形地貌的：山川起伏本身
senses.definition: relating to the physical shape of the land, such as mountains, valleys and coasts
senses.definitionCN: 关于山地、谷地、海岸等自然地表形态的
senses.example: Geographical features such as ridges decide where roads can run.
senses.exampleCN: 山脊这样的地形特征决定了道路可以往哪里修。
senses.why: The earliest geography described the visible face of the earth; the adjective still points to relief and drainage rather than to people.
senses.whyCN: 最早的地理学描述的是大地可见的表面；这个形容词至今仍可指起伏与水系，而非人群。

senses.title: Divided by region
senses.titleCN: 按地区划分的：以区域为单位
senses.definition: organized or counted separately for each region
senses.definitionCN: 按区域分别组织或统计的
senses.example: Sales are reported on a geographical basis, not by product line.
senses.exampleCN: 销售额按地区而非按产品线报告。
senses.why: Because geography partitions the world into regions, the adjective came to describe any arrangement that follows regional boundaries.
senses.whyCN: 由于地理学把世界划分为区域，这个形容词便用来描述任何沿区域边界作出的安排。

senses.title: Of spatial distribution
senses.titleCN: 空间分布的：物种或现象铺开的样子
senses.definition: relating to how something is spread across space
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物在空间上如何铺展开的
senses.example: The geographical distribution of the beetle stops at the frost line.
senses.exampleCN: 这种甲虫的地理分布止于霜冻线。
senses.why: Distribution needs a map: the adjective ties a pattern of occurrence to the places where it holds.
senses.whyCN: 分布需要一张地图：这个形容词把出现规律与发生地点绑定起来。

senses.title: Of a place's physical setting
senses.titleCN: 地理环境的：某地的自然条件
senses.definition: relating to the natural conditions of a particular place, such as climate, soil and water
senses.definitionCN: 关于某地气候、土壤、水源等自然条件的
senses.example: Geographical conditions limit how much rice the valley can produce.
senses.exampleCN: 地理环境条件限制了这条谷地能产多少稻米。
senses.why: Place-based description shifts from 'where it is' to 'what it is like there', which is the environmental reading of the same word.
senses.whyCN: 以地点为基础的描述从“它在哪”转向“那里条件如何”，这就是同一个词的环境义读法。

senses.title: Of a trade origin label
senses.titleCN: 地理标志的：产地名称的法律保护
senses.definition: in trade law, naming a product whose reputation is tied to a specific place
senses.definitionCN: 贸易法中指产品声誉与特定产地绑定的名称保护
senses.example: Champagne is protected as a geographical indication in many markets.
senses.exampleCN: 香槟在许多市场作为地理标志受到保护。
senses.why: If a product's quality comes from its region, the region's name becomes the legal asset; the adjective marks that kind of protected name.
senses.whyCN: 当产品品质源自其地区时，地区名本身就成了法律资产；这个形容词标记的正是这类受保护的名称。

senses.title: Of maps and coordinates
senses.titleCN: 地图与坐标的：测绘所用的
senses.definition: relating to mapping, survey grids and coordinates
senses.definitionCN: 关于地图绘制、测量网格与坐标的
senses.example: Every site is recorded with its geographical coordinates.
senses.exampleCN: 每个地点都用其地理坐标记录。
senses.why: Description of the earth requires a grid; the adjective extends from the described surface to the instruments that describe it.
senses.whyCN: 描述大地需要一套网格；这个形容词从被描述的表面延伸到用于描述它的工具。

intro.en: Geographical joins Greek geo- 'earth' and -graphical 'relating to writing or drawing', through the ancient compound geographia 'description of the earth'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geographical 由希腊 geo-“大地”与 -graphical“与书写、描绘有关的”组合而成，中间经过古代复合词 geographia“对大地的描述”。年代为约数。

items.en: Greek gē meant 'earth, land', and graphein meant 'to write, scratch, draw'. Joined as geōgraphia, the compound meant 'a writing about the earth'. The coinage is generally attributed to Eratosthenes in the 3rd century BC.
items.cn: 希腊 gē 意为“大地、陆地”，graphein 意为“书写、刻画、描绘”。合为 geōgraphia，意为“关于大地的记述”。该复合词的创制一般认为是公元前 3 世纪的埃拉托色尼。

items.en: Latin took the word as geographia, and French formed géographie. English geography appears in the 16th century alongside the older borrowings of the same Greek stems.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 geographia，法语构成 géographie。英语 geography 于 16 世纪出现，与同一希腊词干的更早借词并行。

items.en: The ending -ical comes from Latin -icalis, itself from Greek -ikos, the suffix that makes 'relating to' adjectives. Latin geographicus and Greek geōgraphikos both existed.
items.cn: 后缀 -ical 来自拉丁 -icalis，后者又出自希腊 -ikos，即构成“与……有关”形容词的后缀。拉丁 geographicus 与希腊 geōgraphikos 均已存在。

items.en: Geographical enters English in the 16th century as the adjective of the new discipline, competing with geographic ever since.
items.cn: geographical 于 16 世纪进入英语，作为这门新学科的形容词，此后一直与 geographic 并存竞争。

items.en: The 20th century added geographical indication in trade law and geographical information systems in computing, both extending 'about places' into new fields.
items.cn: 20 世纪新增了贸易法中的地理标志与计算领域的地理信息系统，都把“关于地点”延伸到新领域。

items.en: The date of Eratosthenes' coinage is reported by later writers rather than by a surviving title page, and the deeper origin of graphein is disputed; it is often linked to a root meaning 'to scratch'.
items.cn: 埃拉托色尼创制此词的年代来自后世记述，而非存世的书名页；graphein 的更深来源有争议，常被联系到一个意为“刻划”的词根。

note.en: The first group contains close spelling relatives from the same roots; the second contains words about space and place that do not share the earth-description core.
note.cn: 第一组是同根形近词；第二组是谈空间与地点、但不含“描述大地”这一核心的词。

entries.definition: The shorter adjective of geography, preferred in North American usage before nouns. It differs from geographical in style, not in sense.
entries.definitionCN: geography 的较短形容词，北美用法中更常置于名词前；与 geographical 的差别在风格而非词义。

entries.definition: An adverb about rock structure and deep time, from -logy 'study', not from -graphy 'description'. It answers 'how old and how formed', not 'where'.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，谈岩层构造与漫长年代，来自 -logy“研究”而非 -graphy“描述”；它回答“多古老、怎么形成”，而非“在哪里”。

entries.definition: Relating to shape and measurement, from metron 'measure'. It shares geo- with geographical but has nothing to do with places.
entries.definitionCN: 关于形状与度量，来自 metron“测量”；与 geographical 共用 geo-，但与地点无关。

entries.definition: Relating to space and position in any frame, including rooms and graphs; it does not require the earth's surface.
entries.definitionCN: 关于任何框架中的空间与位置，包括房间和图表；不要求涉及地表。

entries.definition: Relating to territory held by a state or animal; it adds ownership or defence, which geographical does not.
entries.definitionCN: 关于国家或动物所占的领地；带有归属或防卫含义，而 geographical 没有。

entries.definition: Relating to a region within a country; it names an administrative scale rather than a physical setting.
entries.definitionCN: 关于国内某一区域；标明的是一种行政尺度，而非自然条件。

entries.definition: Relating specifically to the detailed relief of a surface, from topos 'place' and graphein 'write'; narrower than geographical.
entries.definitionCN: 专指地表起伏细节，来自 topos“地点”与 graphein“书写”；比 geographical 更窄。

entries.definition: In geography, 'physical' contrasts natural features with human ones; the pair physical geography and human geography marks that split.
entries.definitionCN: 在地理学中，“自然的”与“人文的”相对；自然地理与人文地理这一对术语正体现该分工。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + graph- 'write' + -ical: a written description of the earth.
normal.cn: geo-“大地”+ graph-“书写”+ -ical：对大地所作的书面描述。

normal.en: geography is the noun, geographer the person, geographic and geographical the adjectives, geographically the adverb.
normal.cn: geography 是名词，geographer 指人，geographic 与 geographical 是形容词，geographically 是副词。

normal.en: The phrase geographical distribution is the standard label for range maps.
normal.cn: 地理分布是分布图的标准说法。

normal.en: geographical indication is a legal term, not a synonym for location.
normal.cn: 地理标志是法律术语，不是“位置”的同义词。

normal.en: geology, geometry and geography all begin with geo-, but their second elements mean study, measure and write.
normal.cn: geology、geometry、geography 都以 geo- 开头，但第二部分分别是研究、测量、书写。

abstract.en: Picture a folded map spread on a table, its contour lines tightening as the hills rise.
abstract.cn: 想象一张摊在桌上的折叠地图，山越高，等高线越密。

abstract.en: Picture a dotted range map where the dots stop exactly at a cold coastline.
abstract.cn: 想象一张打点分布图，点阵恰好在寒冷的海岸线处停止。

abstract.en: Picture a wine bottle whose label carries a place name protected by law.
abstract.cn: 想象一只酒瓶，标签上印着受法律保护的产地名。

examples.en: Geographical barriers kept the two languages apart for centuries.
examples.cn: 地理屏障使这两种语言分隔了数个世纪。

examples.en: The team compared the geographical spread of the disease across three provinces.
examples.cn: 研究组比较了该疾病在三个省份的地理分布。

examples.en: Under the agreement, the name can no longer be used as a geographical indication by other producers.
examples.cn: 根据该协议，其他生产者不得再将该名称作为地理标志使用。

dict_mnemonic.text: “记（geo）一下地图（graph）” → geographical 地理的、按地区划分的

root: 希腊 gē“大地”+ graphein“书写、描绘”→ geōgraphia“对大地的记述”；拉丁 geographia、法语 géographie → 英语 geography + -ical。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all return to one act: writing down what the earth looks like, and then sorting the world by the places so described.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都回到同一个动作：把大地的样子书写下来，再按这样描述出的地点来划分世界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contour map in which every line writes down the shape of the land.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张等高线地图，每条线都在书写大地的形状。

branches.en: PLACE AND DISCIPLINE: the adjective serves both the position of a town and the academic study of places.
branches.cn: 位置与学科：这个形容词既服务于一城的位置，也服务于关于地点的学术研究。

branches.en: PHYSICAL SETTING: landforms and local climate are the visible and environmental faces of the same description.
branches.cn: 自然条件：地形与地方气候是同一描述的外观面与环境面。

branches.en: SORTING SPACE: reporting by region and mapping a range both slice the world along lines drawn on a map.
branches.cn: 切分空间：按地区报告与绘制分布范围，都沿地图上画出的线切开世界。

branches.en: LEGAL PLACE: a product tied to a region turns a place name into protected property.
branches.cn: 法律上的地点：与地区绑定的产品把地名变成受保护的财产。

branches.en: THE GRID: coordinates are description made numerical, so the map can be read by machines.
branches.cn: 网格：坐标是数值化的描述，使地图可被机器读取。

intro.en: Geographical is a three-part build: the Greek prefix geo-, the Greek stem graph-, and the adjective ending -ical. All three are still productive in English.
intro.cn: geographical 由三部分构成：希腊前缀 geo-、希腊词干 graph-、形容词词尾 -ical。三者在英语中仍有构词能力。

latinIntro.en: The same Greek stems travel through Latin borrowings into dozens of English words: geography, geology, geometry, graph, paragraph, photograph, biography and telegraph.
latinIntro.cn: 同一批希腊词干经拉丁借词进入大量英语词：geography、geology、geometry、graph、paragraph、photograph、biography、telegraph。

items.example: The atlas groups the plates by geographical region.
items.exampleCN: 这本地图集按地理区域编排图版。

items.meaning: the study or description of the earth's surface

items.exampleCN: 她给中学生教地理。

items.exampleCN: 这位地理学家把河边的每个村庄都绘入地图。

items.example: The report includes a geographic breakdown of sales.
items.exampleCN: 报告包含按地理划分的销售数据。

items.meaning: in terms of rock structure and deep time
items.meaningCN: 从地质构造与深远年代的角度
items.example: Geologically, the valley is very young.
items.exampleCN: 从地质上看，这条谷地非常年轻。

items.meaning: measurement of the earth, now the study of shape
items.meaningCN: 原为土地测量，今指几何学
items.example: The bridge design depends on plain geometry.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥的设计依赖基础几何。

items.meaning: a drawing that shows how values relate
items.meaningCN: 用图线表示数值关系的图表
items.example: The graph shows rainfall against temperature.
items.exampleCN: 这张图显示降雨量与温度的关系。

items.meaning: treating the earth as the centre

definition_zh: 地质的；地质学的；岩层构造的；地质年代的
definition_en: relating to the structure, materials and long history of the earth's rocks, or to the timescales over which they formed
core_image: 一堵被错断的岩墙，两边的层理错开了半米
scene: 这里指「地质的」。 The fault is a geological boundary that no road builder can ignore.

senses.title: Belonging to the science of geology
senses.titleCN: 地质学的：作为学科的一部分
senses.definition: belonging to or produced by the scientific study of the earth's solid materials
senses.definitionCN: 属于研究地球固体物质的科学，或由其产生的
senses.example: The paper appears in a geological journal, not a biological one.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文发表在地质学期刊上，而非生物学刊物。
senses.why: geology names the discipline, and -ical makes the relational adjective: anything marked geological belongs to that field's work.
senses.whyCN: geology 是学科名，-ical 构成关系形容词：凡被标记为 geological 的，都属于该领域的工作。

senses.title: Of strata and their order
senses.titleCN: 岩层的：层理与叠压次序
senses.definition: relating to the layering of rock and the order in which one bed lies on another
senses.definitionCN: 关于岩石的层状构造以及一层压在另一层之上的次序
senses.example: A geological section shows the sandstone below the shale.
senses.exampleCN: 一幅地质剖面显示砂岩位于页岩之下。
senses.why: The first task of geology was to put rock beds in order, so the adjective points at stacked layers before anything else.
senses.whyCN: 地质学最早的任务就是给岩层排序，因此这个形容词首先指向叠压的层。

senses.title: Of deep time
senses.titleCN: 地质年代的：以百万年计的尺度
senses.definition: relating to the very long timescales over which rocks form and continents move
senses.definitionCN: 关于岩石形成、大陆漂移所经历的极长时间尺度
senses.example: Geological time makes a thousand years look like a single breath.
senses.exampleCN: 在地质年代尺度上，一千年短得像一次呼吸。
senses.why: Rock processes run far slower than human history, so geology needed a separate clock, and the adjective names that clock's units.
senses.whyCN: 岩石过程远比人类历史缓慢，因此地质学需要另一套时钟，而这个形容词指的就是那套时钟的单位。

senses.title: Of rock structure
senses.titleCN: 地质构造的：断层、褶皱与节理
senses.definition: relating to the deformation of rock, such as faults, folds and joints
senses.definitionCN: 关于岩石变形，如断层、褶皱与节理的
senses.example: The tunnel had to be rerouted around a geological fault.
senses.exampleCN: 隧道不得不改线以避开一条地质断层。
senses.why: Beds that were once flat are now broken and bent; the adjective covers the structures produced by that deformation.
senses.whyCN: 曾经平躺的岩层如今破裂弯折；这个形容词覆盖的正是这种变形所产生的构造。

senses.title: Of survey and exploration
senses.titleCN: 地质调查的：测绘与勘探工作
senses.definition: relating to systematic mapping, sampling and testing of the ground
senses.definitionCN: 关于对地下进行系统测绘、采样与测试的
senses.example: A geological survey of the region began before the dam was designed.
senses.exampleCN: 在设计水坝之前，该地区的地质调查就已开始。
senses.why: Before anyone builds or drills, the ground must be described; the adjective marks that descriptive and testing phase.
senses.whyCN: 在建造或钻探之前，必须先描述地下情况；这个形容词标记的正是那一描述与测试阶段。

senses.title: Of active earth processes
senses.titleCN: 地质活动的：地震、火山与侵蚀
senses.definition: relating to processes that move or melt rock, such as earthquakes, eruptions and erosion
senses.definitionCN: 关于使岩石移动或熔融的过程，如地震、喷发与侵蚀
senses.example: The coast is shaped by geological processes that operate over millennia.
senses.exampleCN: 这条海岸由持续数千年的地质过程塑造。
senses.why: Structure is not static: the same forces that made the layers keep breaking them, and the adjective extends to those forces.
senses.whyCN: 构造并非静止：造出层理的力量仍在破坏层理，这个形容词便延伸到这些力量上。

senses.title: Of underground storage
senses.titleCN: 地质封存的：把物质存入岩层
senses.definition: relating to long-term storage of substances such as carbon dioxide in deep rock formations
senses.definitionCN: 关于把二氧化碳等物质长期存入深部岩层的
senses.example: The project injects carbon dioxide into a geological storage site under the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目把二氧化碳注入海底的一处地质封存场地。
senses.why: Deep porous rock can hold fluids for geological timescales, so engineers borrowed the adjective for that kind of vault.
senses.whyCN: 深部多孔岩石能在地质时间尺度上容纳流体，于是工程人员借这个形容词来指称这类“地下库房”。

senses.title: Of protected earth heritage
senses.titleCN: 地质遗产的：值得保护的岩景
senses.definition: relating to landforms or rock exposures preserved for their scientific or educational value
senses.definitionCN: 关于因科学或教育价值而被保护的地貌或岩石露头的
senses.example: The gorge became a geological heritage site in 1998.
senses.exampleCN: 这条峡谷于 1998 年成为地质遗产地。
senses.why: When a rock exposure is treated as a document to keep rather than a resource to use, the adjective shifts from study to conservation.
senses.whyCN: 当某处岩石露头被视为需要保存的文献、而不是可利用的资源时，这个形容词就从研究转向保护。

intro.en: Geological is geology plus -ical, built on Greek gē 'earth' and -logia 'account, study'. The word is modern; the parts are ancient. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geological 是 geology 加 -ical，词基为希腊 gē“大地”与 -logia“论述、研究”。词是近代的，构件则古老。年代为约数。

items.en: gē 'earth' and logos 'word, account, reason' combine in geologia, an account of the earth. Classical use of the compound is thin, so its early meaning is inferred rather than documented.
items.cn: gē“大地”与 logos“言词、记述、道理”合成 geologia，即关于大地的论述。该复合词在古典时期用例稀少，其早期含义属推断而非有据可查。

items.en: The Latinized geologia appears in the 17th century for descriptions of earthly materials. Different writers coined it independently, so no single originator is certain.
items.cn: 拉丁化形式 geologia 于 17 世纪出现，用于描述地球物质。不同作者各自创用，因此没有确定的唯一首创者。

items.en: In the late 18th century geology narrowed to the study of strata and earth history, and the adjective geological followed the new discipline.
items.cn: 18 世纪后期，geology 收窄为研究地层与地球历史的学科，形容词 geological 也随之指向这门新学科。

items.en: -ical comes from Latin -icalis, from Greek -ikos, the suffix of relation. Latin had geologicus, and English formed geological on the same pattern as logical and physical.
items.cn: -ical 来自拉丁 -icalis，后者出自希腊 -ikos，即关系形容词后缀。拉丁已有 geologicus，英语按 logical、physical 的同一模式造出 geological。

items.en: The 20th century added geological storage in climate engineering and geological heritage in conservation, both using 'deep rock and deep time' as their base.
items.cn: 20 世纪新增气候工程中的地质封存与保护领域的地质遗产，两者都以“深部岩层与深远年代”为基底。

items.en: Exact first dates for geology and geological in their modern senses are uncertain, and the range of meanings carried by Greek logos is still debated.
items.cn: geology 与 geological 在现代义上的确切首见年代存疑；希腊 logos 所承载的意义范围至今仍有争论。

note.en: The first group contains forms of the same word family; the second contains adjectives for neighbouring branches of earth science.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词族的不同形式；第二组是相邻地球科学分支的形容词。

entries.definition: The clipped adjective of geology, frequent in North American technical writing. The difference from geological is stylistic.
entries.definitionCN: geology 的截短形容词，北美技术写作中常见；与 geological 的差别在风格。

entries.definition: The discipline or a region's rock structure. It cannot modify another noun the way geological does.
entries.definitionCN: 指学科或某地的岩石构造；不能像 geological 那样修饰其他名词。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning 'in geological terms'. It modifies verbs and whole clauses, not nouns.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，意为“从地质上看”，修饰动词或整句，而非名词。

entries.definition: The specialist who practises geology. It is a countable person noun, not a description of rock.
entries.definitionCN: 从事地质学的专家；是可数的人物名词，不描述岩石。

entries.definition: Relating to the deformation of the earth's crust at plate scale; narrower than geological, which covers materials, time and process alike.
entries.definitionCN: 关于板块尺度上地壳的变形；比 geological 窄，后者同时覆盖物质、时间与过程。

entries.definition: Relating specifically to the order and correlation of strata; one branch of what geological covers.
entries.definitionCN: 专指地层的层序与对比，只是 geological 所覆盖内容中的一个分支。

entries.definition: Relating to the composition and crystallography of minerals rather than to whole rock bodies.
entries.definitionCN: 关于矿物的成分与结晶学，而非整个岩体。

entries.definition: Relating to the shape of landforms and the processes that carve them; it studies surfaces, while geological also studies what lies beneath.
entries.definitionCN: 关于地貌形态及其塑造过程；它研究地表，而 geological 也研究地下。

entries.definition: Relating to earthquake waves and vibration; used in geological work but limited to the shaking itself.
entries.definitionCN: 关于地震波与震动；虽用于地质工作，但只限于震动本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + -logical 'relating to study': belonging to the study of the earth.
normal.cn: geo-“大地”+ -logical“与研究有关”：属于研究大地的学问。

normal.en: geology is the field, geologist the person, geological the adjective, geologically the adverb.
normal.cn: geology 是学科，geologist 是人，geological 是形容词，geologically 是副词。

normal.en: geological time is the phrase that carries sense 3; geological survey carries senses 1, 2 and 5.
normal.cn: geological time 承载第 3 个义项；geological survey 承载第 1、2、5 个义项。

normal.en: The family includes geology, geologist, geologically, geochronology and geochemistry.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 geology、geologist、geologically、geochronology、geochemistry。

normal.en: geological describes rock; geographic describes place. The second element decides the meaning.
normal.cn: geological 描述岩石，geographic 描述地点；第二个构件决定词义。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid on a cliff, each tick worth a million years.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺子贴在崖壁上，每一格代表一百万年。

abstract.en: Picture a flat cake of rock cut and pushed sideways, its layers offset like a broken comb.
abstract.cn: 想象一块平整的岩层被切开并横向错动，层理像断了的梳齿。

abstract.en: Picture carbon dioxide sealed in stone pores under the sea, held for longer than humans have existed.
abstract.cn: 想象二氧化碳被封在海底岩石的孔隙里，封存时间比人类存在的历史还长。

examples.en: The geological record shows that the lake dried out at least three times.
examples.cn: 地质记录显示，这个湖至少干涸过三次。

examples.en: Engineers stopped drilling when they hit a geological formation too hard to bore through.
examples.cn: 工程师遇到一层硬得无法钻透的地质建造，于是停止钻进。

examples.en: The park was listed as a geological heritage site because of its folded limestone.
examples.cn: 这座公园因褶皱石灰岩而被列为地质遗产地。

dict_mnemonic.text: “地（geo）层有逻辑（logical）地叠着”——一层压一层 → geological 地质的、岩层的

root: 希腊 gē“大地”+ logos“论述、道理”→ geologia；拉丁 geologicus + 英语 -ical（关系形容词后缀）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the science itself to the layers it reads, the clock it uses, the structures it maps, the work it does and the ground it protects.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从这门学科本身，延伸到它阅读的岩层、它使用的时钟、它测绘的构造、它开展的工作，以及它保护的地面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rock wall whose bands are broken and offset along a fault.
core.cn: 核心意象：一堵层带被断层错开的岩壁。

branches.en: SCIENCE AND STRUCTURE: the discipline and the broken beds it describes belong to one frame.
branches.cn: 学科与构造：这门学科与它所描述的破裂岩层属于同一个框架。

branches.en: ORDER AND TIME: stacked beds are a clock, and reading their order is reading elapsed time.
branches.cn: 层序与时间：叠压的岩层就是一座钟，读层序就是读流逝的时间。

branches.en: FIELDWORK: before use comes description, so survey is the practical face of the adjective.
branches.cn: 野外工作：在使用之前先有描述，因此调查是这个形容词的实践面。

branches.en: LIVING EARTH: the same forces still break, melt and carry rock away.
branches.cn: 活动的地球：同一批力量仍在破坏、熔融并搬走岩石。

branches.en: TWO USES OF DEEP ROCK: one stores what industry must bury, the other preserves what science must keep.
branches.cn: 深部岩层的两种用途：一个封存工业必须埋掉的东西，一个保存科学必须留住的东西。

intro.en: Geological is geology plus -ical. The prefix geo- and the combining form -log- both come from Greek and remain productive.
intro.cn: geological 是 geology 加 -ical。前缀 geo- 与组合成分 -log- 都来自希腊语，至今仍有构词能力。

latinIntro.en: Through Latin, Greek geo- and -logia produced a dense family: geology, geologist, geophysics, geochemistry, biology, theology and ecology all share the pattern.
latinIntro.cn: 经拉丁语传承，希腊 geo- 与 -logia 造出密集词族：geology、geologist、geophysics、geochemistry、biology、theology、ecology 都共享这一模式。

items.meaning: relating to the study of the earth's rocks
items.meaningCN: 与地球岩石研究有关的
items.example: The map's legend explains each geological unit.
items.exampleCN: 该图图例解释了每一个地质单元。

items.meaning: the science of the earth's solid matter
items.meaningCN: 研究地球固体物质的科学
items.example: Geology explains why the two hills differ in age.
items.exampleCN: 地质学解释了这两座山丘年龄不同的原因。

items.example: The geologist dated the ash by its crystals.
items.exampleCN: 地质学家通过晶体测定了火山灰的年代。

items.meaning: in terms of rock structure or deep time
items.meaningCN: 从岩石构造或深远年代的角度
items.example: Geologically, the two banks are quite different.
items.exampleCN: 从地质上看，两岸差别很大。

items.meaning: the dating of rocks and events
items.meaningCN: 测定岩石与事件年代的分支
items.example: Geochronology fixed the eruption at about 74,000 years ago.
items.exampleCN: 地质年代学把这次喷发定在约七万四千年前。

items.example: Geochemistry traces the metal to a deep source.
items.exampleCN: 地球化学把这批金属追溯到深部来源。

items.meaning: the physics of the earth and its fields
items.meaningCN: 地球及其各种场的物理学
items.example: Geophysics revealed a dense body under the plain.
items.exampleCN: 地球物理探测揭示了平原下方的高密度体。

items.meaning: relating to crustal building and deformation
items.meaningCN: 与地壳建造和变形有关的
items.example: Tectonic uplift raised the plateau by two kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 构造抬升把高原升高了两千米。

latinEntries.meaning: an account of the earth (Latinized Greek)
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于大地的论述（拉丁化的希腊词）

latinEntries.meaning: relating to the study of the earth

latinEntries.meaningCN: 关系形容词词尾，意为“与……有关的”

definition_zh: 地质学家；地质工作者；研究岩层与地球历史的人
definition_en: a scientist who studies rocks, layers, minerals and the long history of the earth, often by fieldwork as well as laboratory analysis
core_image: 一个人蹲在岩壁前，手举地质锤敲下一块带层理的岩石
scene: 这里指「地质学家」。 The geologist read the cliff like a page, naming each layer in order.
sceneCN: 这里 geologist 是「地质学家」的本义（第 1 个义项：以岩层为研究对象的人）；句意：这位地质学家像读一页书那样读那道崖壁，依次说出每一层。图中可辨识物件：地质锤、放大镜、岩层剖面、记录本、安全帽。

pos.zh: 地质学家；地质工作者（可数名词，复数形式规则变化）

senses.title: A scientist of rocks and strata
senses.titleCN: 岩石与地层的研究者：本义
senses.definition: a scientist whose subject is the solid earth, its rocks, minerals and layered history
senses.definitionCN: 以固体地球、岩石、矿物与层状历史为研究对象的科学家
senses.example: A geologist can date the flow of lava from its mineral grains.
senses.exampleCN: 地质学家能根据矿物颗粒测定熔岩流出的年代。
senses.why: geology joins Greek gē 'earth' and -logia 'study, account'; -ist marks the person, so a geologist is literally 'one who studies the earth'.
senses.whyCN: geology 由希腊 gē“大地”与 -logia“研究、论述”构成，-ist 标记从事者，因此 geologist 字面就是“研究大地的人”。

senses.title: The field worker
senses.titleCN: 野外地质工作者：在山野里读岩的人
senses.definition: one who maps and samples rock exposures outdoors rather than only in a laboratory
senses.definitionCN: 在野外测绘、采样岩石露头，而非只在实验室工作的人
senses.example: The geologist spent the summer mapping exposures along the fault.
senses.exampleCN: 这位地质工作者整个夏天都在测绘断层沿线出露的岩体。
senses.why: Because strata are visible only where they break the surface, the profession's core skill has always been reading outcrops in the field.
senses.whyCN: 由于地层只有在出露地表处才可见，这门职业的核心技能始终是在野外读露头。

senses.title: The exploration specialist
senses.titleCN: 资源勘探地质师：找矿找油的人
senses.definition: an applied geologist who locates oil, gas, groundwater or ore for industry
senses.definitionCN: 为工业寻找石油、天然气、地下水或矿石的应用型地质工作者
senses.example: The company hired a geologist to assess the shale under the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 公司聘请了一位地质师评估平原下方的页岩。
senses.why: Industry needs predictions about what lies underground, and that is exactly the stratigraphic reading a geologist supplies.
senses.whyCN: 工业需要关于地下埋藏什么的预测，而这正是地质学家所提供的层序判读。

senses.title: The planetary geologist
senses.titleCN: 行星地质学家：读别的星球表面
senses.definition: a geologist who applies earthly rock science to the surfaces of the moon, Mars or other bodies
senses.definitionCN: 把地球岩石科学用于月球、火星等天体表面的地质学家
senses.example: A planetary geologist compared the crater floors on Mars with basalt fields on earth.
senses.exampleCN: 一位行星地质学家把火星的坑底与地球的玄武岩区作比较。
senses.why: The same processes of impact, flow and erosion leave records elsewhere, so the earth-trained eye transfers to other worlds.
senses.whyCN: 撞击、流动与侵蚀等同一批过程在其他天体也留下记录，因此受训于地球的眼光可转移到别的世界。

senses.title: The engineering geologist
senses.titleCN: 工程地质人员：为建筑判断地基
senses.definition: a geologist who judges ground conditions for tunnels, dams, foundations and slopes
senses.definitionCN: 为隧道、水坝、地基与边坡判断地下条件的地质工作者
senses.example: An engineering geologist warned that the slope would fail after heavy rain.
senses.exampleCN: 一位工程地质人员警告说，大雨之后该边坡会失稳。
senses.why: Buildings rest on materials a geologist can name and test, so the discipline becomes a safety service at construction sites.
senses.whyCN: 建筑坐落在能由地质工作者命名并测试的材料上，于是这门学问在工地变成一项安全服务。

senses.title: The hazard assessor
senses.titleCN: 灾害评估者：判读地震与滑坡风险
senses.definition: one who studies faults, volcanoes and unstable ground to estimate future risk
senses.definitionCN: 研究断层、火山与不稳定地面以估计未来风险的人
senses.example: The geologist mapped old landslide scars before the town expanded.
senses.exampleCN: 在小镇扩建之前，这位地质学家测绘了旧滑坡的痕迹。
senses.why: Past rock movement is written into the landscape; reading it forward into future risk is the hazard branch of the same skill.
senses.whyCN: 过去的岩体运动被写入地貌；把这种记录向前读成未来风险，就是同一技能的风险分支。

senses.title: The map-maker of strata
senses.titleCN: 地层编图者：把岩层画成图
senses.definition: one who compiles geological maps showing the age and arrangement of rock units
senses.definitionCN: 编制显示岩层年代与分布关系的地质图的人
senses.example: The geologist finished a sheet covering four hundred square kilometres.
senses.exampleCN: 这位地质学家完成了一幅覆盖四百平方公里的图幅。
senses.why: A geological map is the profession's written form: the geologist converts scattered outcrops into a continuous picture of what lies beneath.
senses.whyCN: 地质图是这门职业的书面形态：地质学家把零散露头转成一幅连续的地下图景。

senses.title: The teacher and explainer
senses.titleCN: 教学与科普者：把深时讲给人听
senses.definition: a geologist who teaches the subject or explains deep time to the public
senses.definitionCN: 教授这门学科或向公众解释深远年代的地质工作者
senses.example: The geologist showed visitors how a river cuts through a million years in one bank.
senses.exampleCN: 这位地质学家向参观者展示一条河如何在一道岸壁上切开百万年。
senses.why: Deep time is invisible without explanation, so part of the role is turning rock evidence into a story nonspecialists can follow.
senses.whyCN: 深时若不经解释便不可见，因此这一角色的一部分工作就是把岩石证据转成非专业者能跟上的一段叙述。

intro.en: Geologist is geolog(y) plus -ist. The compound is Greek in its parts, Latin in its transmission, and modern in its meaning. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geologist 是 geolog(y) 加 -ist。其构件属希腊语，传承经拉丁语，词义则是近代形成的。年代为约数。

items.en: gē meant 'earth', and logos meant 'word, account, reason'. The compound geologia would have meant 'an account of the earth'; it is not common in surviving classical texts.
items.cn: gē 意为“大地”，logos 意为“言说、记述、道理”。复合形式 geologia 本应意为“关于大地的论述”，在现存古典文本中并不常见。

items.en: The Latinized form geologia appears in the 17th century for the study of the earth's materials. Several writers used it independently, so no single coiner can be named with certainty.
items.cn: 拉丁化形式 geologia 于 17 世纪出现，指对地球物质的研究。多位作者各自使用过它，因此无法确定唯一的创制者。

items.en: Only in the late 18th and early 19th centuries did geology settle on its modern meaning: the study of strata and earth history, with field mapping as its method.
items.cn: 直到 18 世纪末至 19 世纪初，geology 才固定为现代含义：研究地层与地球历史，以野外填图为方法。

items.en: -ist comes from Greek -istēs through Latin -ista and French -iste, and names a person engaged in something. Geologist is recorded from the late 18th century.
items.cn: -ist 经拉丁 -ista、法语 -iste 来自希腊 -istēs，指从事某事的人。geologist 的记录可追溯到 18 世纪后期。

items.en: The 20th century split the role into branches such as petroleum geologist, engineering geologist and planetary geologist.
items.cn: 20 世纪把这个角色分化为石油地质师、工程地质人员、行星地质学家等分支。

items.en: The first use of geologia and of geologist is uncertain, and the deeper sense of Greek logos ranges from 'word' to 'reason', so the original force of the compound is disputed.
items.cn: geologia 与 geologist 的首见年代存疑；希腊 logos 的深层含义从“言词”到“道理”不等，因此该复合词最初的含义有争议。

note.en: The first group contains words built on the same stems; the second contains other earth-science specialists who study different materials.
note.cn: 第一组是同一词干构成的词；第二组是研究不同对象的其他地球科学专家。

entries.definition: The discipline itself, or the rock structure of a region. A geologist practises geology.
entries.definitionCN: 指学科本身或某地的地质构造；地质学家从事的是这门学科。

entries.definition: Relating to geology, as in geological map or geological time. It cannot stand for a person.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，如地质图、地质年代；不能用来指人。

entries.definition: An obsolete variant for a geologist, formed with -er instead of -ist. It appears only in older texts.
entries.definitionCN: 地质学家的废弃变体，以 -er 而非 -ist 构成，仅见于旧文本。

entries.definition: A specialist in the description of places, climate and distribution, from -graphy 'write'; a geologist reads strata, a geographer maps surfaces and peoples.
entries.definitionCN: 专长于描述地点、气候与分布，源自 -graphy“书写”；地质学家读地层，地理学家绘地表与人群。

entries.definition: Anyone studying the planet, including oceans, atmosphere and magnetism; a geologist is one member of this wider group.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地球的任何人，包括海洋、大气与地磁；地质学家是这一更大群体中的一个分支。

entries.definition: One who studies the chemistry and structure of minerals rather than whole rock sequences.
entries.definitionCN: 研究矿物的化学成分与结构，而非整套岩层序列的人。

entries.definition: One who records and interprets seismic waves; a geologist may study faults, but a seismologist measures the shaking itself.
entries.definitionCN: 记录并解释地震波的人；地质学家可以研究断层，但地震学家测量的是震动本身。

entries.definition: One who specializes in volcanic systems and eruptions, a narrower branch of geology.
entries.definitionCN: 专攻火山系统与喷发的人，是地质学中更窄的分支。

entries.definition: A person who searches for ore or gold, often by practical experience rather than formal geological training.
entries.definitionCN: 寻找矿石或黄金的人，常凭实践经验而非正规地质训练。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + -logy 'study' + -ist 'person': the person who studies the earth.
normal.cn: geo-“大地”+ -logy“研究”+ -ist“人”：研究大地的人。

normal.en: geology is the field, geologist is the person, geological is the adjective; keep the trio straight.
normal.cn: geology 是学科，geologist 是人，geological 是形容词；三者要分清。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: field geologist, petroleum geologist, planetary geologist, engineering geologist.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各分支：野外地质工作者、石油地质师、行星地质学家、工程地质人员。

normal.en: A geologist's basic tools are the hammer, the hand lens and the notebook.
normal.cn: 地质工作者的基本工具是地质锤、放大镜和记录本。

normal.en: Do not confuse geologist with geographer: rocks versus places.
normal.cn: 别把 geologist 与 geographer 混淆：一个是岩石，一个是地点。

abstract.en: Picture a cliff face as a stack of pages, each layer a sentence written in sand and shell.
abstract.cn: 想象崖壁是一叠书页，每一层都是用沙与贝壳写下的句子。

abstract.en: Picture a hammer tapping a stone and a clock hand jumping back a million years with each blow.
abstract.cn: 想象锤子敲一下石头，时钟的指针就回跳一百万年。

abstract.en: Picture scattered outcrops joined by faint lines into one continuous underground sheet.
abstract.cn: 想象零散露头被细线连成一整幅连续的地下图纸。

examples.en: The geologist sampled the ash layer on both sides of the valley to compare the two sections.
examples.cn: 这位地质学家在谷地两侧都采了火山灰层样品，以对比两个剖面。

examples.en: After the earthquake, a geologist measured how far the fence had been offset.
examples.cn: 地震之后，一位地质学家测量了栅栏被错开的距离。

examples.en: The museum's geologist explains to school groups why the fossils are older than the lava above them.
examples.cn: 博物馆的地质学家向学生团体解释，为什么化石比覆盖其上的熔岩更古老。

dict_mnemonic.text: “地（geo）质学家爱敲石头（logist 像‘逻辑师’）”——读岩层如读书 → geologist 地质学家

root: 希腊 gē“大地”+ logos“言说、道理”→ geologia“关于大地的论述”；拉丁 geologia + -ist（从事者后缀）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses belong to one figure: a person who reads stone. The same reader moves from outcrop to industry, to other planets, to risk, to maps and to the classroom.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都属于同一个人物：读石头的人。这同一个读石者从露头走向工业、走向别的星球、走向风险、走向地图，最后走向课堂。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a kneeling figure tapping a layered cliff with a hammer.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个蹲在层状崖壁前、用锤子敲击的人。

branches.en: THE READER: the scientist and the field worker are the same core role seen in the library and on the cliff.
branches.cn: 读石者：学科专家与野外工作者是同一核心角色在书房与崖壁上的两种样子。

branches.en: RESOURCES: reading strata becomes a service to mining, oil and water supply.
branches.cn: 资源：读地层变成对采矿、石油与供水的服务。

branches.en: OTHER GROUND: the same eye is turned to other planets and to the ground under a dam.
branches.cn: 别处的地面：同一双眼睛转向别的行星，也转向水坝之下的土地。

branches.en: RISK AND RECORD: old movement becomes future hazard, and scattered evidence becomes a published map.
branches.cn: 风险与记录：过去的运动变成未来的风险，零散证据变成公开发表的地图。

branches.en: THE EXPLAINER: the geologist also converts deep time into words the public can hold.
branches.cn: 解释者：地质学家还负责把深时转换成公众能把握的语言。

intro.en: Geologist is a clean three-part word: geo- 'earth', -log- 'study or account', -ist 'person'. The middle element is the same one that gives logic and dialogue.
intro.cn: geologist 是清晰的三段式词：geo-“大地”、-log-“研究或论述”、-ist“人”。中间这一段也构成 logic 与 dialogue。

latinIntro.en: Greek logos supplied a whole family through Latin and French: logic, dialogue, biology, geology, theology, psychology and technology all carry -logy or -logue.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 logos 经拉丁与法语衍生出整族词：logic、dialogue、biology、geology、theology、psychology、technology 都带 -logy 或 -logue。

items.meaning: a person who studies the earth's rocks
items.example: The geologist logged the section in a waterproof notebook.
items.exampleCN: 这位地质学家在防水本上记录了该剖面。

items.meaning: the science of the earth's solid materials
items.meaningCN: 研究地球固体物质的科学
items.example: The geology of the basin is dominated by sandstone.
items.exampleCN: 该盆地的地质以砂岩为主。

items.meaning: relating to rock structure and earth history
items.meaningCN: 与岩层构造和地球历史有关的
items.example: The survey produced a new geological map.
items.exampleCN: 这次调查绘制了新的地质图。

items.example: Geologic time is measured in millions of years.
items.exampleCN: 地质年代以百万年计。

items.meaning: the chemistry of rocks and fluids
items.meaningCN: 岩石与流体的化学研究
items.example: Geochemistry can reveal where the granite came from.
items.exampleCN: 地球化学能揭示花岗岩的来源。

items.meaning: the physics of the earth's interior and fields
items.meaningCN: 研究地球内部与场的物理学
items.example: Geophysics locates the ore body without digging.
items.exampleCN: 地球物理学不必开挖就能定位矿体。

items.meaning: the study of living things; shows -logy at work
items.meaningCN: 研究生物的科学；展示 -logy 的构词方式
items.example: Biology and geology meet in the study of fossils.
items.exampleCN: 生物学与地质学在化石研究中相遇。

items.meaning: the study of valid reasoning, from the same logos
items.meaningCN: 研究有效推理的学问，同出 logos
items.example: The argument's logic is sound even if its data are thin.
items.exampleCN: 即便数据单薄，这个论证的逻辑仍然成立。

latinEntries.meaning: a word, an account, or reasoned explanation
an account of the earth (early modern Latin)
latinEntries.meaningCN: 关于大地的论述（早期近代拉丁）

definition_zh: 几何的；几何图形的；按几何级数变化的
definition_en: relating to geometry or to patterns built from simple shapes; also, increasing or decreasing by a constant ratio
core_image: 地砖上的方与三角依次套叠，每一层都把上一层按同一比例放大
scene: 地砖上是方与三角套叠的图案，每一层都把上一层按同一比例放大。The tiles form a geometric pattern of squares inside squares.
sceneCN: 这里 geometric 指「由规则几何图形构成的」（第 2 个义项：图形化的几何构成）；句意为这些砖构成方中套方的几何图案。图中可辨识物件：地砖、正方形、三角形、放大比例。

pos.zh: 几何的；几何图形的；按固定比例增减的

senses.title: Belonging to geometry
senses.definition: relating to the branch of mathematics that studies shape and space
senses.definitionCN: 与研究形与空间的数学分支有关
senses.example: The proof uses a geometric argument about similar triangles.
senses.exampleCN: 这个证明用了一个关于相似三角形的几何论证。
senses.why: The plainest reading attaches the branch's name to the thing described.
senses.whyCN: 最朴素的用法把分支之名挂到所描述的对象上。

senses.title: Built from simple shapes
senses.definition: made up of regular shapes such as circles, squares and triangles
senses.definitionCN: 由圆、方、三角等规则图形组成
senses.example: The tiles form a geometric pattern of squares inside squares.
senses.exampleCN: 这些砖构成方中套方的几何图案。
senses.why: A pattern is called geometric when its parts are exact figures rather than organic or irregular forms.
senses.whyCN: 当图案的部件是精确图形而非有机、不规则形状时，就称它为几何的。

senses.title: Changing by a constant ratio
senses.definition: describing a sequence in which each term is a fixed multiple of the one before
senses.definitionCN: 描述每一项都是前一项固定倍数的数列
senses.example: Bacteria in a fresh dish grow in a geometric progression.
senses.exampleCN: 新培养皿里的细菌按等比速度增长。
senses.why: This sense comes from proportion rather than from shape: in Greek usage the word covered ratios as well as figures.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自比例而非形状：在希腊语用法中，这个词既涵盖图形，也涵盖比值。

senses.title: Of a mean found by multiplying
senses.definition: describing the mean obtained by multiplying values and taking a root, rather than by adding
senses.definitionCN: 描述通过相乘再开方、而非相加得到的平均数
senses.example: The geometric mean of four and nine is six.
senses.exampleCN: 四与九的几何平均是六。
senses.why: Algebraic operations named after figures because early proofs of them were drawn as areas.
senses.whyCN: 以图形命名的代数运算，因为早期对它们的证明要画成面积。

senses.title: Severely regular in design
senses.definition: describing design or art that uses straight lines, exact angles and repeated units
senses.definitionCN: 描述使用直线、精确角度与重复单元的设计或艺术
senses.example: The façade is geometric, with no curve anywhere.
senses.exampleCN: 这面外墙是几何式的，没有一处曲线。
senses.why: Design is called geometric when its units are exact figures repeated by rule rather than shaped by hand.
senses.whyCN: 当设计的单元是精确图形、按规则重复而非手工塑形时，便称它为几何式的。

senses.title: Of geometric abstraction in art
senses.definition: belonging to a modern style that reduces images to circles, rectangles and grids
senses.definitionCN: 属于把形象简化为圆、矩形与网格的现代风格
senses.example: Mondrian's geometric canvases were once thought cold.
senses.exampleCN: 蒙德里安的几何画作一度被认为冷冰冰。
senses.why: The style took its name from the figures it used, so the adjective became a label for a movement.
senses.whyCN: 这一风格以所用图形为名，于是这个形容词成了流派的标签。

senses.title: Describable in exact spatial terms
senses.titleCN: 可用精确空间关系描述的
senses.definition: described by distances, angles and positions rather than by feel
senses.definitionCN: 用距离、角度与位置来描述，而非凭感觉
senses.example: The dancer's turns became geometric once the cameras measured them.
senses.exampleCN: 一旦摄像机量过，舞者的转身就变得几何化了。
senses.why: Any motion reduced to coordinates can be described geometrically, which is what the adjective claims.
senses.whyCN: 任何化为坐标的运动都可用几何方式描述，这正是这个形容词所主张的。

senses.title: As strict as a construction
senses.titleCN: 像作图一样严格的（比喻）
senses.definition: used of reasoning that proceeds step by step with no room for approximation
senses.definitionCN: 描述一步一步推进、不容许近似余地的推理
senses.example: His refusal was geometric: each condition ruled out the next.
senses.exampleCN: 他的拒绝像作图一样严格：每个条件都排除了下一步。
senses.why: The figurative use borrows the certainty of a construction, where each line is forced by the previous one.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法借用作图的确定性：每条线都被前一条逼出来。

intro.en: The adjective is the Greek noun for land measurement plus the Greek suffix for 'belonging to'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个形容词是希腊语表示丈量土地的名词加表示「属于」的希腊后缀。年代均为约数。

items.en: Geōmetria meant 'land measurement', a compound of ge 'earth' and metron 'measure'.
items.cn: geōmetria 意为「丈量土地」，由表示土地的词与表示量度的词合成。

items.en: Geōmetrikos 'of measuring land, skilled in geometry' was formed with -ikos, the suffix of belonging.
items.cn: geōmetrikos「丈量土地的、精于几何的」由表示「属于」的后缀构成。

items.en: Latin took the adjective as geometricus alongside the noun geometria, and both entered the schools together.
items.cn: 拉丁语把形容词作为 geometricus 与名词一并吸收，两者一同进入学校。

items.en: English uses the adjective from the sixteenth century for proofs, figures and designs, and the longer variant survives in older texts.
items.cn: 英语自十六世纪起用这个形容词指证明、图形与设计，较长的变体留在较早文献中。

items.en: Greek usage already covered proportion, so the adjective could describe a constant ratio as well as a shape; this is why a progression can be geometric.
items.cn: 希腊语用法已涵盖比例，因此这个形容词既能描述形状，也能描述固定比值；这正是数列也能称「几何」的原因。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word became the name of a style that reduced images to exact figures. First date uncertain: the label spread through criticism rather than through a single coining.
items.cn: 二十世纪时这个词成了一派把形象简化为精确图形的风格之名。首见年代不确定：这个标签经评论界扩散，而非出自某一次命名。

note.en: Group one separates the adjective from near forms; group two separates words for regular arrangement.
note.cn: 第一组辨析这个形容词与邻近形式；第二组辨析表示规则排布的词。

entries.definition: The branch itself; the adjective differs from it by its ending, which is easy to lose in a fast scan.
entries.definitionCN: 指分支本身；形容词与它只差词尾，快速扫读时容易漏看。

entries.definition: A longer form of the same adjective, common in older writing; modern usage prefers the shorter one before nouns.
entries.definitionCN: 同一形容词的较长形式，多见于较早写作；现代用法在名词前多用较短者。

entries.definition: A specialist in the branch; the ending marks a person rather than a quality.
entries.definitionCN: 指该分支的专家；词尾标出人而非性质。

entries.definition: Describes balance about an axis; a geometric pattern may be symmetrical, but symmetry is not required.
entries.definitionCN: 描述关于某轴的平衡；几何图案可以对称，但对称并非必要条件。

entries.definition: Describes things full of angles or sharp corners, without implying exact figures.
entries.definitionCN: 描述多角或尖角之物，并不暗示精确图形。

entries.definition: Describes a fixed relationship between quantities; a geometric progression is one kind of proportional change.
entries.definitionCN: 描述量之间的固定关系；等比变化是比例变化的一种。

entries.definition: Describes growth by a constant multiplying factor; it is the modern technical term where geometric is the older one.
entries.definitionCN: 描述按固定倍数增长；这是现代技术术语，而几何一词是较早的说法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the branch name plus a suffix of belonging, so it marks whatever can be described in figures.
normal.cn: 这个形容词是分支名加表示归属的后缀，因此标记可用图形描述的一切。

normal.en: Its oldest technical phrases are pattern, shape, progression and mean.
normal.cn: 它最老的技术搭配是图案、图形、数列与平均。

normal.en: A geometric progression multiplies, an arithmetic one adds: the difference is the operation between terms.
normal.cn: 等比数列做乘法，等差数列做加法：差别就在相邻项之间的运算。

normal.en: The family runs geometry, geometric, geometrical, geometrically, geometer.
normal.cn: 同族词包括几何、几何的、较长形容词、在几何上、几何学家。

normal.en: In art the word became a label: exact figures instead of curves and likenesses.
normal.cn: 在艺术中这个词成了标签：用精确图形取代曲线与肖似。

abstract.en: Picture a tile repeating a smaller copy of itself, four times over.
abstract.cn: 想象一块砖把自身的缩小复制一遍，如此重复四次。

abstract.en: Picture a drawing that refuses every wobble, as if a ruler were holding the pen.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画拒绝任何抖动，仿佛有一把尺在管着笔。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose every step is exactly twice the height of the one before.
abstract.cn: 想象一道楼梯，每一级的高度正好是前一级的两倍。

examples.en: The garden was laid out in a geometric pattern of circles and squares.
examples.cn: 花园按圆与方的几何图案布置。

examples.en: Population grew geometrically for three decades.
examples.cn: 人口以几何速度增长了三十年。

examples.en: The artist moved from portraits to pure geometric forms.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家从肖像转向纯几何形式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「量地的」：分支名加表示归属的尾巴 → 几何的、规则的

root: 希腊 geōmetrikos「丈量土地的、精于几何的」= ge「土地」+ metron「量度」+ 表示归属的后缀；拉丁 geometricus 与名词一并入学校；希腊用法已含比例义，故等比数列也称几何；二十世纪又成为几何抽象艺术之名。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fan out from one adjective: belonging to the branch, built from exact shapes, changing by a fixed ratio, computed by multiplication, strictly linear in design, naming an art movement, exactly measurable in space, and as forced as a construction.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个形容词扇开：属于该分支、由精确图形构成、按固定比值变化、以乘法计算、设计上严格使用直线、命名一个艺术流派、在空间上可精确测量，以及像作图一样步步被迫。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: tiles nested inside tiles, each layer an exact enlargement of the one before.
core.cn: 核心意象：砖块层层套叠，每一层都是上一层的精确放大。

branches.en: The branch and its measurement: a proof about triangles, and a motion reduced to coordinates.
branches.cn: 分支与测量：关于三角形的证明，与化为坐标的运动。

branches.en: Figures in space and on a façade: the same exactness applied to pattern and to design.
branches.cn: 空间中与墙面上的图形：同一种精确性用于图案与设计。

branches.en: Ratio and multiplying mean: the older proportional sense that makes a progression geometric.
branches.cn: 比值与相乘的平均：使数列可称几何的较旧比例义。

branches.en: The movement: exact figures became a style and then a label.
branches.cn: 流派：精确图形成了风格，再成标签。

branches.en: The forced step: each line follows from the previous one with no approximation allowed.
branches.cn: 被迫的一步：每条线都由前一条逼出，不容近似。

intro.en: The adjective keeps the two Greek nouns of its parent and adds a suffix of belonging, so it reads as the branch name turned into a modifier.
intro.cn: 这个形容词保留了母词的两个希腊名词并加上表示归属的后缀，因此读起来是分支名转成的修饰语。

latinIntro.en: Ge and metron supply the meaning, -ikos makes the adjective, and Latin -icus carried it into English.
latinIntro.cn: 土地与量度两个词提供意义，希腊后缀构成形容词，拉丁词尾把它带入英语。

items.example: The first element keeps the measuring tied to land.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分把测量系在土地上。

items.example: The second element supplies measuring and, later, ratio.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分提供测量，后来也提供比值。

items.example: The suffix turns the compound into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把复合词变成形容词。

items.example: The Greek adjective already covered both shape and ratio.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊形容词已兼指形状与比值。

items.meaning: of geometry; in a fixed ratio
items.example: English keeps both the shape and the ratio senses.
items.exampleCN: 英语同时保留形状义与比值义。

items.example: Older writing preferred the longer adjective.
items.exampleCN: 较早写作偏爱较长的形容词。

items.example: The adverb marks the terms of description.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记描述所用的方式。

items.example: The person suffix closes the family.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀收拢词族。

items.meaning: a mean found by multiplying and taking a root
items.meaningCN: 相乘再开方所得的平均
items.example: The phrase records the ratio sense in technical form.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语以技术形式记录了比值义。

definition_zh: 几何学；几何结构；空间布局
definition_en: the study of shapes, sizes, and space, or the shape of something
core_image: 一块黑板上画着三角形、圆和交叉的直线
scene: 学生们在几何课上画三角形。The students drew triangles in geometry class.
sceneCN: 这里 geometry 是「几何学」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学生们在几何课上画三角形。

senses.title: Study of shapes
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics about points, lines, angles, and shapes
senses.definitionCN: 研究点、线、角和形状的数学分支
senses.example: The students drew triangles in geometry class.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在几何课上画三角形。
senses.why: Geometry began as the measuring of land.
senses.whyCN: 几何学最初是测量土地的方法。

senses.title: Shape and structure
senses.definition: the shape and arrangement of the parts of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物各部分的形状与排列
senses.example: The bridge is admired for its simple geometry.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥因简洁的几何结构而为人称道。
senses.why: The rules of shapes became a way to describe real objects.
senses.whyCN: 形状的规律成了描述真实物体的方式。

senses.title: Layout in space
senses.definition: the way things are arranged in space
senses.definitionCN: 事物在空间中的排列方式
senses.example: The geometry of the streets guides traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 街道的布局引导着车流。
senses.why: A measured space becomes a planned space.
senses.whyCN: 被测量的空间变成了被规划的空间。

intro.en: Geometry was named by the Greeks as the measuring of the earth.
intro.cn: geometry 由希腊人命名，意为「测量大地」。

items.en: Ge meant the earth.
items.cn: ge 意为大地。

items.en: Metron meant measure.
items.cn: metron 意为测量。

items.en: Geometria meant land measurement.
items.cn: geometria 意为土地测量。

items.en: Latin took the word as geometria.
items.cn: 拉丁语以 geometria 的形式吸收了这个词。

items.en: It entered English as the mathematics of shape and space.
items.cn: 它进入英语，表示研究形状与空间的数学。

note.en: Geometry is compared with look-alike words and related fields of mathematics.
note.cn: 把 geometry 与形近词以及相关数学分支作比较。

entries.definition: the study of the earth and its places
entries.definitionCN: 地理学

entries.definition: the study of rocks and the earth
entries.definitionCN: 地质学

entries.definition: balanced shape on two sides
entries.definitionCN: 对称

entries.definition: mathematics with letters in place of numbers
entries.definitionCN: 代数

entries.definition: the mathematics of triangles
entries.definitionCN: 三角学

entries.definition: the outline or form of something
entries.definitionCN: 形状

normalIntro.en: Geometry is the mathematics of how things are shaped and placed.
normalIntro.cn: geometry 是研究事物形状与位置的数学。

normal.en: The students drew triangles in geometry class.
normal.cn: 学生们在几何课上画三角形。

normal.en: The bridge is admired for its simple geometry.
normal.cn: 这座桥因简洁的几何结构而为人称道。

normal.en: The geometry of the streets guides traffic.
normal.cn: 街道的布局引导着车流。

normal.en: Plane geometry deals with flat shapes.
normal.cn: 平面几何研究平面图形。

normal.en: She checked the geometry of the design.
normal.cn: 她检查了设计的几何结构。

abstract.en: Every building is an argument made of angles.
abstract.cn: 每一栋建筑都是用一个又一个角写成的论证。

abstract.en: Space becomes a plan once it is measured.
abstract.cn: 空间一旦被测量，就变成了规划。

abstract.en: The shortest path is a straight line only on paper.
abstract.cn: 最短的路，只有在纸上才是一条直线。

examples.en: The students drew triangles in geometry class.
examples.cn: 学生们在几何课上画三角形。

examples.en: The bridge is admired for its simple geometry.
examples.cn: 这座桥因简洁的几何结构而为人称道。

examples.en: The geometry of the streets guides traffic.
examples.cn: 街道的布局引导着车流。

dict_mnemonic.text: geo- 表示「大地」，-metry 表示「测量」：最初测量土地的办法就是 geometry（几何学）；plane geometry 是「平面几何」，the geometry of 是「……的几何结构」。

root: 来自希腊语 geo（大地）加 metron（测量），经拉丁语 geometria 进入英语，核心义「测量大地」。

sensesIntro.en: Geometry means the mathematics of shape, the structure of an object, or the layout of things in space.
sensesIntro.cn: geometry 意为研究形状的数学、物体的结构，或事物在空间中的布局。

core.en: Space measured into lines, angles, and forms.
core.cn: 被测量成线、角与形状的空间。

branches.en: A ruler and compass draw a perfect circle.
branches.cn: 直尺和圆规画出一个完美的圆。

branches.en: Steel beams meet at clean angles.
branches.cn: 钢梁以干净的角相接。

branches.en: Streets form a grid across the city.
branches.cn: 街道在城市中形成网格。

branches.en: The rules of drawing become the rules of building.
branches.cn: 作图的规则变成了建造的规则。

branches.en: Shape and placement are two readings of one plan.
branches.cn: 形状与位置是同一份规划的两种读法。

intro.en: Geometry combines the earth root geo with the measuring root metry.
intro.cn: geometry 由表示大地的词根 geo 与表示测量的词根 metry 组成。

latinIntro.en: Latin geometria came from Greek words for earth and measure.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 geometria 来自希腊语中表示大地和测量的词。

items.example: Geometry studies shapes and space.
items.exampleCN: 几何学研究形状与空间。

items.example: The rug has a geometric pattern.
items.exampleCN: 这块地毯有几何图案。

items.example: The proof is geometrical.
items.exampleCN: 这个证明是几何学的。

items.example: The two shapes are geometrically equal.
items.exampleCN: 这两个形状在几何上相等。

items.example: The geometer proved the theorem.
items.exampleCN: 这位几何学家证明了这个定理。

items.example: Geography and geometry share a root.
items.exampleCN: 地理学与几何学共享一个词根。

items.example: Geology studies rock layers.
items.exampleCN: 地质学研究岩层。

items.example: Trigonometry measures angles.
items.exampleCN: 三角学测量角度。

latinEntries.example: Geometria is the parent of geometry.
latinEntries.exampleCN: geometria 是 geometry 的前身。

latinEntries.example: Metron appears in many measuring words.
latinEntries.exampleCN: metron 出现在许多表示测量的词里。
